doc: View lab (docs/view-lab/PLAN.md): the camera's projection per view id, picked by the launch flag --view=<id> (default `top`, the shipped 90-degree orthographic view, bit-identical: no transform is applied). pitch_deg is the camera's angle above the ground (90 = straight down); the ground plane is foreshortened by sin(pitch) on screen y (Camera2D zoom.y), so the mouse unprojects onto the ground through the same canvas transform. height_k scales how far a part's height lifts it up the screen (cos(pitch), the 2.5D actors; 0 = flat). Render only: a view never writes to the sim. cards (optional, default false) draws the upright facing cards (the head/bust drawn for the raised camera, 5 facings drawn + 3 mirrored, features/characters/art/view/) over the top-down head under a tilt.

views.note: the shipped view: straight down, orthographic, untouched
still 90 degrees, with height cues (cast shadows, wall extrusion, rim light)

the main candidate (DECISION it5): 55 degrees with the upright facing cards (Rivet, King, gang, patrol cop); picked from the 65 / 55 / 45 stills at 32 px/m: 65 barely differs from top, 45 squashes the ground to 71 % and the top-down limbs read squat
pitch study: 65 degrees, no cards (the it2 `tilt`)
pitch study: 45 degrees, the stronger three-quarter end of the range
